target_audience: Founders, marketers and creators who need finished ad-ready creative — images, videos, UGC, voiceovers, product photography — without a production team.
value_proposition: An AI creative production team: 10 skills that route every brief to the best generation model, write the prompt properly, and hand back finished images, videos, UGC clips, voiceovers and product photos.
pain_points: Creative production is the bottleneck of every campaign — a single ad video takes days and freelancers
Raw model access produces weak results without model routing and prompt craft
Product photos, UGC and voiceovers each need different tools, accounts and skills
proof_points: Routes across 10+ SOTA image/video/audio models (Nano Banana, GPT Image, Veo, Kling, ElevenLabs) per brief
Each skill encodes the prompt guide for its models — no raw-prompt roulette
The same skills run in Claude Code, Cursor, Gemini CLI and the hosted SuperCMO agent
